messages:
Sam (AE): FYI NovaHealth procurement is insisting on a bank guarantee/standby LC for the EU pilot instead of marketplace invoices. They want EU-only processing and customer KMS. Need legal + finance guidance and an expedited routing. @Priya @Li

Priya (legal): We can accept an irrevocable standby LC if it's a direct orderform (not AWS Marketplace). LC must name Redwood Inference, Inc. as beneficiary and reference the orderform number. I'll prepare an MSA + DPA redline adding EU-only processing, SCCs/EU Addendum, KMS terms, and LC conditions.

Omar (solutions): For EU-only we can spin up a dedicated pilot in eu-west-1. Customer-managed KMS is supported but needs IAM onboarding. That adds ~EUR 2.7k/month to the pilot. Lead time 3-5 business days.

Li (finance): Treasury accepts scanned bank-issued LC with SWIFT confirmation provided it's irrevocable and payable to our entity. Require LC to cover full pilot fee + €350 admin. If they insist on Marketplace, LC won't work because AWS handles payments.

Sam (AE): Customer PO snippet they sent:
```
PO#: NH-PO-2026-998
Term: 90-day pilot
Amount: EUR 16,500
Payment method: Standby LC via GlobalTrust Bank (SWIFT GTBCEUR2)
AP email: ap@novahealth.com
```

Priya (legal): Add requirement: LC expiry >= 30 days after pilot end and LC must reference the signed orderform. If LC not received 10 days before start, we can delay kickoff or cancel. I'll attach redline here in ~4 hours.

Omar (solutions): If we need LC in place 10 days prior, earliest practical start moves out a week. KMS onboarding checklist will be ready EOD.

Li (finance): I'll confirm exact LC beneficiary language and send to Priya. Also will flag that we prefer digital signature on orderform; bank originals are optional if SWIFT confirm provided.

ProvisionBot: Provisioning note: Dedicated EU pilot requested. Estimated incremental cost EUR 2,700/month. Provision queued pending signed orderform and LC.

Sam (AE): Actions: Priya drafts MSA/DPA/orderform redline; Li sends treasury LC language; Omar prepares KMS checklist & cost estimate; I'll ask customer if scanned LC + SWIFT confirmation is acceptable and request bank contact. ETA: EOD. Thanks all.
